name: AdamW

var.description: Variable tensor to update. Supports float32, float16, bfloat16.

m.description: First moment estimates, same shape as var, dtype float32.

v.description: Second moment estimates, same shape as var, dtype float32.

grad.description: Gradient tensor, same shape and dtype as var.

beta1_power.description: float, beta1 power for bias correction.

beta2_power.description: float, beta2 power for bias correction.

beta1.description: float, exponential decay rate for first moment.

beta2.description: float, exponential decay rate for second moment.

epsilon.description: float, small constant for numerical stability.

use_nesterov.description: bool, whether to use Nesterov momentum.

var_out.description: Updated variable tensor, same shape and dtype as var.

m_out.description: Updated first moment, same shape and dtype as m.

v_out.description: Updated second moment, same shape and dtype as v.

reference:
import torch
import torch_npu

def run(var, m, v, grad, beta1_power, beta2_power, lr, beta1, beta2, epsilon, use_locking=False, use_nesterov=False):
    if var.dtype == torch.float16:
        orig_dtype = var.dtype
        var_f32 = var.float()
        m_f32 = torch.zeros_like(m, dtype=torch.float32)
        v_f32 = torch.zeros_like(v, dtype=torch.float32)
        grad_f32 = grad.float()
        m_new = beta1 * m_f32 + (1 - beta1) * grad_f32
        v_new = beta2 * v_f32 + (1 - beta2) * grad_f32 * grad_f32
        m_hat = m_new / (1 - beta1_power)
        v_hat = v_new / (1 - beta2_power)
        if use_nesterov:
            m_nesterov = beta1 * m_hat + (1 - beta1) * grad_f32 / (1 - beta1_power)
            var_new = var_f32 - lr * m_nesterov / (torch.sqrt(v_hat) + epsilon)
        else:
            var_new = var_f32 - lr * m_hat / (torch.sqrt(v_hat) + epsilon)
        return var_new.to(orig_dtype), m_new.to(m.dtype), v_new.to(v.dtype)
    var_out = var.clone()
    m_out = torch.zeros_like(m)
    v_out = torch.zeros_like(v)
    torch_npu.npu_apply_adam(beta1_power, beta2_power, lr, beta1, beta2, epsilon,
                              grad, use_locking, use_nesterov, out=(var_out, m_out, v_out))
    return var_out, m_out, v_out

def forward(self, var: torch.Tensor, m: torch.Tensor, v: torch.Tensor,
            grad: torch.Tensor, beta1_power: float, beta2_power: float,
            lr: float, beta1: float, beta2: float, epsilon: float,
            use_locking: bool = False, use_nesterov: bool = False):
    orig_dtype = var.dtype

    var_f32 = var.float()
    m_f32 = m.float()
    v_f32 = v.float()
    grad_f32 = grad.float()

    m_new = beta1 * m_f32 + (1 - beta1) * grad_f32
    v_new = beta2 * v_f32 + (1 - beta2) * grad_f32 * grad_f32

    m_hat = m_new / (1 - beta1_power)
    v_hat = v_new / (1 - beta2_power)

    if use_nesterov:
        m_nesterov = beta1 * m_hat + (1 - beta1) * grad_f32 / (1 - beta1_power)
        var_new = var_f32 - lr * m_nesterov / (torch.sqrt(v_hat) + epsilon)
    else:
        var_new = var_f32 - lr * m_hat / (torch.sqrt(v_hat) + epsilon)

    var_out = var_new.to(orig_dtype)
    m_out = m_new.to(m.dtype)
    v_out = v_new.to(v.dtype)

    return var_out, m_out, v_out
